standard_prerequisites.name: Extension from coherent to quasi-coherent modules by filtered colimits, and the affineness criterion by vanishing of $H^1$
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter spaces-cohomology.tex, labels lemma-directed-colimit-coherent and lemma-colimits (invoked at proof line 3434) and label proposition-vanishing-affine (invoked at proof line 3436)
standard_prerequisites.use: They reduce affineness of $X$ to the vanishing of $H^1(X, \mathcal{F}) = 0$ for all coherent $\mathcal{F}$, which is what the rest of the proof establishes.

standard_prerequisites.name: The criterion reducing a property of coherent sheaves on a Noetherian space to irreducible supports
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter spaces-cohomology.tex, label lemma-property-higher-rank-cohomological (invoked at proof lines 3444 and 3453)
standard_prerequisites.use: Conditions (1) and (2) are verified directly for the property $\mathcal{P}(\mathcal{F}) \Leftrightarrow H^1(X, \mathcal{F}) = 0$, and condition (3) is met by the sheaf $\mathcal{G} = f'_*\mathcal{O}_{Z'}$.

standard_prerequisites.name: The auxiliary finite morphism over a reduced irreducible closed subspace, and the projection formula for an affine morphism
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter spaces-cohomology.tex, labels lemma-finite-morphism-Noetherian (invoked at proof lines 3450 and 3454) and lemma-affine-morphism-projection-ideal (invoked at proof line 3460)
standard_prerequisites.use: The first supplies $Z'$ with $i' : Z' \to Y$, $f' : Z' \to Z$ and the support property (3)(a); the second identifies $\mathcal{G}' = \mathcal{I}\mathcal{G}$ with $f'_*\mathcal{I}'$.

standard_prerequisites.name: Vanishing of the higher direct images of the affine morphisms $f'$ and $i$, with Leray
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter spaces-cohomology.tex, label lemma-affine-vanishing-higher-direct-images (invoked at proof lines 3470 and 3477) and Cohomology on Sites, label sites-cohomology-lemma-apply-Leray (invoked at proof line 3474)
standard_prerequisites.use: Since $f'$ and $i$ are affine, their higher direct images vanish; together with the vanishing of $H^1(Z', \mathcal{I}')$ on the affine space $Z'$ and Leray, this gives $H^1(X, i_*\mathcal{G}') = 0$, which is condition (3)(b).

core_obligations: Reduce affineness of $X$ to the vanishing of $H^1(X, \mathcal{F})$ for every coherent $\mathcal{F}$, extending to quasi-coherent modules by the filtered colimit lemmas and applying the affineness criterion (proof lines 3430-3436).

Define the property $\mathcal{P}(\mathcal{F}) \Leftrightarrow H^1(X, \mathcal{F}) = 0$ and verify conditions (1) (long exact cohomology sequence) and (2) (additivity of $H^1$) of the criterion (proof lines 3438-3448).

Verify condition (3): for a reduced irreducible closed $i : Z \to X$ take the finite morphisms $Z' \to Y$ and $Z' \to Z$ supplied by the auxiliary lemma, set $\mathcal{G} = f'_*\mathcal{O}_{Z'}$, and for a nonzero ideal $\mathcal{I}$ on $Z$ take $\mathcal{G}' = \mathcal{I}\mathcal{G} = f'_*\mathcal{I}'$, whose cokernel in $\mathcal{G}$ is supported in the proper closed subset cut out by $\mathcal{I}$ (proof lines 3448-3468).

Show $H^1(X, i_*\mathcal{G}') = 0$: $f'$ is affine so $R^1f'_*\mathcal{I}' = 0$, the space $Z'$ is affine so $H^1(Z', \mathcal{I}') = 0$, Leray gives $H^1(Z, f'_*\mathcal{I}') = 0$, and since $i$ is affine another Leray computation gives $H^1(X, i_*f'_*\mathcal{I}') = 0$ (proof lines 3469-3479).
proof_roadmap: Reduction to $H^1$ vanishing on coherent modules (proof lines 3430-3436).
Condition (3): the sheaf $\mathcal{G}$ and the subsheaf $\mathcal{G}'$ (proof lines 3448-3468).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a Noetherian algebraic space is affine as soon as it receives a finite surjective morphism from an affine space (statement lines 3416-3427). The proof reduces affineness to the vanishing of the first cohomology of coherent modules, feeds that vanishing property into the criterion on irreducible supports, and verifies the remaining condition by pulling back along the auxiliary finite cover of a reduced irreducible subspace and computing the relevant cohomology through the vanishing of higher direct images of affine morphisms and Leray. The verification of the criterion's condition (3) is the substance, so the claim is H2.
